# Autoencodix

AUTOENCODIX is a Python framework to train, evaluate, explain and share autoencoders for biological data and beyond (bulk and single-cell omics, images, any tabular data). All architectures share one pipeline API (preprocess, fit, predict, visualize, generate, evaluate, explain, save/load) and are configured with validated Pydantic configs; call `<Name>Config.print_schema()` to list all parameters. Pretrained models are on https://huggingface.co/autoencodix. Source: https://github.com/jan-forest/autoencodix_package


## Getting started

- [Home](https://jan-forest.github.io/autoencodix_package/index.md): Overview, installation, quick start, architectures with references, pretrained models
